CLIENT PROJECT / 2025

The Real Chai Company

A little heritage in every cup.

Brand identity · Print
THE STORY

A world of
its own.

The idea

The Real Chai Company brings authentic Indian chai to the UK through handcrafted blends. Its identity needed to honour the ritual, ingredients and cultural heritage behind a real cup of chai.

The design

Handcrafted illustrations, a peacock-inspired logo, elegant typography and a warm palette create an inviting brand world. The system extends across packaging, menus and the small moments where customers meet the brand.
